steps.en: Install Solaar from your distribution's package
steps.zh: 从发行版软件包安装 Solaar

steps.en: Discovers supported receivers and HID++ devices through udev
steps.zh: 通过 udev 发现受支持的接收器与 HID++ 设备

steps.en: Pair a compatible device, or change a device setting in the GUI
steps.zh: 在图形界面配对设备或修改设置

steps.en: Saves the settings and restores them whenever the device reconnects
steps.zh: 保存设置，并在设备重连时恢复

steps.en: Inspect the detected device and its capabilities from the CLI
steps.zh: 用命令行查看设备及其能力

value.en: Pairing, device state and persistent HID++ settings are managed on Linux without vendor software
value.zh: 在 Linux 上管理配对、设备状态与持久化 HID++ 设置，不需要厂商软件

sources: docs/usage.md (GUI discovers devices, restores settings on reconnect, pairing flow)
docs/implementation.md (udev-based discovery of USB, Bluetooth and receiver-connected HID++ devices)
lib/solaar/configuration.py (config.yaml in XDG_CONFIG_HOME, legacy config.json read and converted)
lib/solaar/cli/__init__.py (show / probe / config / profiles / pair / unpair subcommands)
